title: Typed corpus import and claim verification — depth 2
summary: Depth-2 target for importing recovered communications into complete StarIntel records and corroborating individual claims.

unresolved: Recovered messages must still be authenticated and corroborated individually.

notes: Every recovered email must create the complete source, email-message, sender, recipient, body-mention person, and stable-link record set in one transaction.
An authentic artifact does not independently prove every statement inside it.
No credentials or explicit private media are retained.

data.research_question: Which recovered communications can be preserved as typed email-message records, linked to people and sources, and corroborated at the claim level?
objectives: For every email, create a source document, canonical email-message, sender and recipient person records, source-scoped body-mention person records, and stable links.
Preserve original headers, identifiers, timestamps, attachments, and hashes when available.
Resolve identities conservatively and retain unresolved source-scoped people where needed.
Corroborate claims with adjacent messages, DKIM or ARC where present, public records, and independent primary sources.
hypotheses: A substantial subset of communications may be independently verifiable even where the enclosing archive lacks a published root checksum.
Typed entity and claim separation prevents authored statements from becoming unsupported factual edges.
excluded_sources: body claims detached from their source artifact
out_of_scope: treating authored claims as established facts

workflow.next_action: Import the first recovered message batch under the permanent email-ingestion invariant and enqueue every unresolved entity and claim.
